command_semantics.actual_command: Privacy-redacted representation of the exact command executed historically; placeholders replace machine-specific path values and were not executed literally.
command_semantics.historical_final_path_command: Privacy-redacted historical equivalent targeting the finalized path; retained as evidence, not portability guidance.
command_semantics.portable_reproduction_command: Project-root-relative command template; replace {python} with python or python3.

historical_execution_context.purpose: Privacy-redacted representation of the machine that executed Stage 2B; placeholders are not literal executed command values or portability guidance.

manifest_migration.result: Only command labeling, portable reproduction fields, and execution-context labeling changed.

portable_reproduction.path_rule: All listed paths are relative to the project root.

privacy_redaction.purpose: Remove personal machine-specific paths from the public submission without changing workload evidence.
privacy_redaction.active_path_policy: Project-contained machine-readable paths are project-root-relative POSIX strings.
privacy_redaction.historical_command_policy: Historical command paths use clearly labelled placeholders and are representations, not literal rerun commands.

placeholders.<PROJECT_ROOT>: Project root used by the historical execution.
placeholders.<PYTHON_EXECUTABLE>: Python executable used by the historical execution.

privacy_redaction.final_manifest_sha256_location: Recorded externally in AI_DECISIONS.md; a manifest never stores its own final digest.
